huggingface.summary: Models for physical AI tasks, such as robotics and autonomous driving, need not reason solely in language. They can use visual plans--points, bounding boxes, and trajectories--to represent spatial goals and anticipate motion. However, autoregressive vision-language models generate these plans one coordinate token at a time, making richer predictions increasingly costly. huggingface.summary: Reliable robotic manipulation requires both semantic understanding and precise control in three-dimensional space. huggingface.title: ToolSpace: Scaling Tool-Centric Environment Synthesis for Long-Horizon Agents
